Also known as the Blue Legs Quest. Collect the four pieces of a broken amulet scattered around Darama, have {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} of Ab'Dendriel repair it and you get the {item:Koshei's Ancient Amulet}. You can keep the amulet or take it to the Darashia catacombs, kill {creature:Koshei the Deathless} and return it to his corpse to open the reward door: the {item:Blue Legs} and your 5,000 gp back.
Level 40 for the {item:Gate of Expertise} in Koshei's room (70+ recommended).
5,000 gp to pay the blacksmith (you get this money back if you complete the quest to the end).
if you leave the quest after repairing the amulet
if you kill Koshei and give the amulet back to him
the 5,000 gp back, only if you finish the quest
in a box on the way to Koshei
Decide before the final part: either you keep the {item:Koshei's Ancient Amulet}, or you continue the quest and **lose the amulet** in exchange for the Blue Legs.
To fight Koshei, at least 2 players of level 40 are recommended; higher levels can do it solo.

In Drefia and the ruins you may find {creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Skeleton Warrior|Skeleton Warriors} and {creature:Tarnished Spirit|Tarnished Spirits}; you may also run into {creature:Slime|Slimes} (Drefia), {creature:Scarab|Scarabs} and {creature:Larva|Larvas} (ruins) drawn in by other players.
1. Collecting the four pieces of the amulet
You have to find the four {item:Piece of a Broken Amulet|pieces of the broken amulet}. The order does not matter.

Travel to **Darashia** by boat (at your city's harbour, {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Petros}). In **Darashia**, enter the {wiki:Bath of Dreams}, the building west of the depot. Look for the {item:Loose Board|loose board} and use it to find the {item:Piece of a Broken Amulet (Mouth)}.

Go to the {wiki:Dark Pyramid}, in the far north-east of Darama. Go down to the **3rd underground floor** and open the {item:Stone Coffin|stone coffin} to get the {item:Piece of a Broken Amulet (Hanger)}. The pyramid is **north-east** of Darashia (see the entrance coordinate); go down the stairs, floor by floor. To leave, go up the same stairs to the surface and walk back to Darashia.
Stone Coffin in the Dark Pyramid

In the **Kha'labal** desert, above the {wiki:Ancient Ruins Tomb}, there is a special {item:Sand (Quest)|sand}. **Use** the sand (do not dig with the shovel) to get the {item:Piece of a Broken Amulet (Nose)}. Kha'labal is the desert between Darashia and Ankrahmun (north of Ankrahmun): walk there from either city. The sand is on the surface, so there is no special way back: walk back to the city.
Do not use the shovel: you have to use the sand directly.

Go to **Drefia** and go down a few floors in the southern part. In the room with a single {creature:Vampire}, open the {item:Stone Coffin|stone coffin} to get the {item:Piece of a Broken Amulet (Eye)}. {wiki:Drefia} is **west** of Darashia, on the other side of the mountains: climb up with the {item:Rope} at the marked rope spot or come through the passage between Darashia and Ankrahmun. To leave, go up through the same floors (use the Rope where you came down through holes) and go back through the mountains to Darashia.
Stone Coffin in the Vampire room (Drefia)
Rope spot to climb up to Drefia
The floors of Drefia have {creature:Skeleton Warrior|Skeleton Warriors}, {creature:Tarnished Spirit|Tarnished Spirits} and {creature:Lich|Liches}.

From Darashia, take {npc:Petros}'s boat to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and from there {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat to **Ab'Dendriel** ({key:ab'dendriel}). Travel to **Ab'Dendriel**. To reach the cyclops blacksmith, go in through the hole in the wheat field east of the depot. To leave, go back to the hole and use the {item:Rope} to climb up to the wheat field.
With the four pieces, say {key:hi}, {key:broken amulet} and {key:yes}. He charges **5,000 gp** and needs 24 hours to repair the amulet.
Wait **24 hours**, come back and say {key:hi} and {key:broken amulet} (or {key:amulet}). You receive the {item:Koshei's Ancient Amulet}.
You can stop here and keep the amulet, but then you do **not** get the 5,000 gp back. If you continue, you lose the amulet. If you lose the amulet, the cyclops will not make another one.
3. Darashia catacombs and Koshei the Deathless
Go to the {wiki:Deeper Catacombs} of Darashia, just east of the city. The entrance is in the **south-east** of Darashia, next to the magic carpet and the boat.
To open the stairs down, light the **2 torches (statues) in the north and east** and make sure all the others stay **unlit**.
Light the north and east torches and then use the Ancient Sundial in the centre
Use the {item:Ancient Sundial} next to the stairs. You hear a *CLICK* in the room to the **south-west**: there, inside a coffin, a staircase has opened. Go down it.
Follow the cave **south** and turn **east** as soon as you can. Go down the stairs and then down the ladder.
Map of the route to Koshei's room
Use the {item:Box|box} to get 100 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}. Then drop through the hidden trapdoor (covered pitfall) in the **south** part of the small room.
Keep walking **north** until you find a level 40 {item:Gate of Expertise}. {creature:Koshei the Deathless} waits inside. He only appears if you have the {item:Koshei's Ancient Amulet} with you.
If you leave Koshei's room, he disappears.
Kill Koshei and use the amulet on the corpse

Kill {creature:Koshei the Deathless} and **straight afterwards** use the {item:Koshei's Ancient Amulet} on his remains (Remains of Koshei). The corpse disappears after a few seconds. If all goes well you see: *"At least I have it back, my precious amulet. I am glad you didn't use it! I allow you to ....ahh....enter door ..... ahh"*.
If you do not use the amulet in time, Koshei is reborn at once in the north, next to the altar, shouting *"YOU FOOL! NOW DIE AND SERVE ME IN HELL!"* and you have to kill him again.
After Koshei is finally dead, go **south** and go in through the {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door} on the **west** side to receive the prize.
Blue Legs and the 5,000 gp back (50 Platinum Coins)

To leave, go back the way you came to the catacomb entrance in the south-east of Darashia (bring the {item:Rope}, which is already on the list). Note: the coffin's secret stairs disappear after you go down, the trapdoor only works downwards and the wiki does not describe the exit from the Koshei area.
The quest is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
If you have already made the amulet and lose it, A Sweaty Cyclops will not make you another (*"Big Ben no has it more!"*).
